purpose: Evaluate the readiness-qualified V9 causal-topology global planner against original M-TARE, with a complete-development-map oracle as a non-deployable upper bound.

approval.scope: One immutable 90-case randomized-block run: tunnel/garage, environment seeds 11/23/37/53/71, 600 seconds per case, original M-TARE three repeats, V9 seeds 0/1/2 once each, and complete-map oracle three repeats per block.
approval.confirmation_reference: The user explicitly authorized the agent to choose and execute the optimal in-scope route without repeated approvals; the original 90-case design was separately approved.

trajectory_and_sampling.trajectory_definition: Each case is one complete closed-loop trajectory from the frozen start; exact identities and randomized order come from the approved matrix and schedule hash.
trajectory_and_sampling.temporal_sampling: Retain every message on the AEE V2 topic contract over the exact 600-second interval after the first valid waypoint.
trajectory_and_sampling.spatial_sampling: Accumulate finite map-frame registered scans in fixed 0.5m voxels; retain trajectories and waypoints without deletion.
trajectory_and_sampling.independence_statement: The ten world-by-environment-seed blocks are paired analysis units. Repeats and checkpoint seeds measure variation and are not additional worlds.

methods.main: V9 organized-LiDAR direction plus B0 count/fixed role -> causal verified graph -> deterministic frontier/Dijkstra -> unchanged M-TARE local planner and controller.
methods.baseline: Original M-TARE global planner with the frozen explicit planner seed, under the same simulator and downstream stack.
methods.necessary_fallback_or_upper_bound: Layered complete-development-map topological oracle; non-deployable and never interpreted as learned.

model_and_teacher.checkpoint_selection: Three V9 ROS checkpoints were frozen before readiness; each executes once per world/seed block.
model_and_teacher.teacher: No teacher or complete map enters original M-TARE or V9. The oracle is an explicit diagnostic reference only.

metrics_and_statistics.analysis: Average each family within each of ten blocks; compare V9 minus original M-TARE using exact two-sided sign-flip, fixed 10,000-sample paired bootstrap CI and Holm correction.
metrics_and_statistics.effect_policy: Execution PASS means faithful completion. Positive, mixed or negative research effect is reported without rerun or method revision.

leakage_and_failure_policy.stop: Any readiness/input/image/checkpoint/topic/layout/timing/startup/runtime/metric/planner/archive/disk/evidence failure seals FAIL and stops without retry.

evidence.per_case: Contract, logs, losslessly verified bag, topic audit, trajectory, coverage curve, waypoints, metrics, exit state, and replacement graph/decision trace with V9 input/fallback provenance.
evidence.aggregate: Exact schedule, matrix audit, family/block statistics, effects, confidence intervals, p-values, stability, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
evidence.expected_pass_counts: 90/90 cases, 10/10 blocks, 30 per family, 54,000 simulated seconds, zero C09/C10/training/optimizer activity.

estimated_cost.compute: Serial CPU/Gazebo/ROS, no GPU; host zstd-10 after every case; 150 GiB free-space floor.
